name: LLC resonant (mains, ZVS, resonant tank, no output choke)

stages.description: AC inlet, fuse, NTC, EMI filter, MOV
stages.fail_note: No AC input reaching the primary. Check the AC inlet, fuse, and NTC. A blown primary fuse indicates a downstream short — do NOT replace without finding it.

stages.description: Bridge rectifier (4 diodes or bridge block)
stages.fail_note: Bridge rectifier fault. Check the bridge for short/open. A shorted bridge blows the primary fuse.
Bulk cap voltage wrong. A shorted bulk cap blows the fuse; an open/degraded cap causes low DC and ripple.

stages.description: PFC pre-regulator (LLC always has PFC for mains)
stages.fail_note: PFC stage fault. LLC requires a regulated ~380V DC input.

stages.description: Controller VCC (internal LDO or external bias)
stages.fail_note: Controller VCC missing. The IC cannot run. Check the VCC decoupling cap and the VCC feed (internal LDO or bias winding).
Controller not enabled or no reference. Check EN source and the internal Vref.

stages.description: Half-bridge or full-bridge driving the resonant tank
stages.fail_note: Bridge switch fault. LLC achieves ZVS via the resonant tank; hard-switching from a detuned tank destroys the FETs.

stages.description: Resonant tank: Lr (resonant inductor) + Cr (resonant cap) + Lm (magnetizing)
stages.fail_note: Resonant tank fault. A shifted resonant cap or inductor detunes the tank — the converter loses ZVS and efficiency collapses. This stage is STRUCTURALLY UNIQUE to LLC (no equivalent in buck/boost/flyback). Check Cr for drift and Lr for shorted turns.

stages.description: LLC transformer (part of the resonant network via Lm)
Secondary: center-tap + 2 schottky/sync FETs (no output choke in LLC)
stages.fail_note: Secondary rectifier fault. LLC has NO output choke (the resonant tank filters the current) — distinctive from forward/push-pull.

stages.description: Output cap only (no choke in LLC)
Isolated feedback: secondary TL431 + optocoupler across isolation barrier
stages.fail_note: Feedback path fault across the isolation barrier. Check the TL431 reference, the optocoupler CTR, and the secondary-side feedback divider. An open optocoupler drives the primary to max duty; a shorted TL431 drives min duty.
PGOOD not asserted or protection tripping. Check the PGOOD pull-up and the OVP/OCP monitors.

fault_patterns.notes: LLC: resonant-tank detune is the distinctive fault.
LLC overheating = lost ZVS from tank detune.
